Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 8 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Hema - 35 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Vikram - 41 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The classroom - a blackboard, benches
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
4. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Hema and Vikram stand near him.]

Hema: "What lovely weather!"

[Aarav writes in his notebook.]

Hema: "Well done!"

[Aarav studies for his exam.]

Hema (laughing): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Aarav does his homework at the table.]

Vikram: "One more time!"

[Aarav talks to his father on the phone.]

Hema: "What next?"

Scene 2: The classroom - Day

[Aarav stands in the classroom. Hema and Vikram stand near him.]

Hema: "Let's begin."

[Aarav reads his book at his desk.]

Aarav: "That was fun!"

[Aarav yawns in the class.]

Aarav: "Oh wow!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "Aarav, look over here."

[Aarav shakes his head.]

Aarav (excited): "Careful!"

[Aarav takes the bag from Mother.]

Aarav (excited): "How beautiful!"

[Aarav sneezes loudly.]

Aarav: "And then?"

[Aarav coughs.]

Hema (gently): "Oh wow!"

[Thick fog covers the village.]

Aarav: "Careful!"

Scene 4: The garden - Day

[Aarav stands in the garden. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "Let's begin."

[Aarav waters the plants.]

Hema (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Aarav chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Aarav (gently): "What a day to remember!"
